Definition: Number of campaign leads handed over to Sales in the month that the Sales Executive marked as Qualified under the three qualification criteria. A lead counts in the month it was qualified, not the month it was created.
Formula: Count of leads with stage Qualified and a campaign source
Target: Set in the annual marketing plan

Definition: Campaign spend in the month divided by the qualified leads attributed to that spend. Spend includes advertising, agency fees and event costs recorded against the campaign budget line.
Formula: Campaign spend / M001
Target: Set per campaign in the brief

Definition: Share of campaigns launched in the month whose campaign log contains all four approval steps before the launch date. A campaign approved after launch counts as incomplete.
Formula: Campaigns with complete approval before launch / campaigns launched

Definition: Unsubscribes caused by an email campaign divided by the emails delivered for that campaign. Unsubscribe requests received by reply are included once they are processed.
Formula: Unsubscribes / emails delivered

Definition: Spam complaints for an email campaign divided by the emails delivered. When the rate goes above 0.3 percent the next send to that segment is stopped.
Formula: Complaints / emails delivered

Definition: Share of campaign leads created in the CRM that were handed over to Sales within 1 business day of the lead being received.
Formula: Leads handed over within 1 business day / leads received

Definition: Spend on always-on digital advertising in the calendar month across all advertising accounts of the Company. Checked every Monday against the monthly limit.
Formula: Sum of advertising spend in the month

Definition: Revenue of contracts signed in the quarter compared with the Sales Executive's quarterly target. Revenue is counted at contract signature.
Formula: Signed contract value / quarterly target

Definition: Share of leads created in the quarter that reached the Qualified stage by the end of the following month.
Formula: Qualified leads / leads created

Definition: Share of qualified opportunities that ended as Closed-Won. Opportunities still open at the end of the period are excluded.
Formula: Closed-Won / (Closed-Won + Closed-Lost)

Definition: Share of customer interactions logged in the CRM within 24 hours of taking place. Applies to calls, meetings and emails with prospects and customers.
Formula: Interactions logged within 24 hours / interactions logged

Definition: Difference between the revenue forecast at the start of the month and the revenue actually signed in that month, as a share of the forecast. Reviewed by the Branch Manager.
Formula: 1 - abs(actual - forecast) / forecast

Definition: Share of incoming customer issues that received an acknowledgement with a ticket ID within 2 business hours, measured within the hours of the shift that received the issue.
Formula: Issues acknowledged in time / issues received

Definition: Share of tickets closed at Tier 1 without escalation and without the customer reopening them within 7 calendar days.
Formula: Tickets resolved at first contact / tickets closed

Definition: Share of escalations raised within 1 business hour of the escalation trigger: 24 hours without resolution, or a safety, legal or financial risk identified.
Formula: Escalations raised in time / escalations raised

Definition: Median time from ticket creation to resolution, reported separately for P1, P2, P3 and P4 tickets and compared with the resolution targets.
Formula: Median(resolved at - created at) per priority
Target: P1 4 business hours; P2 1 business day; P3 3 business days; P4 5 business days

Definition: Average score of the satisfaction survey sent when a ticket is closed, on a scale from 1 to 5. Tickets without a survey answer are excluded.
Formula: Sum of scores / answered surveys

Definition: Number of published knowledge articles whose last review is older than 6 months.
Formula: Count of articles with last review older than 6 months

Definition: Share of partner-school sessions in the delivery calendar that took place on the planned date. Sessions moved by the school more than 5 business days ahead are excluded.
Formula: Sessions delivered on the planned date / sessions planned

Definition: Share of field visit reports submitted within 1 business day of the visit.
Formula: Reports submitted within 1 business day / field visits

Definition: Share of newly signed partner schools whose kickoff call took place within 3 business days of contract signature.
Formula: Kickoffs within 3 business days / contracts signed

Definition: Number of follow-up actions from visit reports that are still open more than 10 business days after their due date.
Formula: Count of overdue follow-up actions

Definition: Share of purchase orders delivered on or before the delivery date on the purchase order, per vendor and in total.
Formula: Orders delivered on time / orders delivered

Definition: Share of vendor invoices that matched the purchase order and the delivery confirmation at the first check.
Formula: Invoices matched at first check / invoices received

Definition: Share of approved expense claims paid within 10 business days of Finance Associate verification.
Formula: Claims paid in time / claims approved

Definition: Number of payments made in the month that did not carry every approval required by DOC-09 §4 or the purchase order limits of DOC-12 §3.1.
Formula: Count of payments with missing approvals

Definition: Whether the month-end close was completed by the third business day of the following month.
Formula: Close completion date <= third business day

Definition: Difference between actual spend and budget for the year to date, per department and per budget line, as a share of the budget. Lines above 10 percent need an explanation from the budget owner.
Formula: (actual year to date - budget year to date) / budget year to date

Definition: Share of new hires who completed every mandatory module of their onboarding learning path before the end of the 60-day probation period.
Formula: New hires with all mandatory modules completed by day 60 / new hires

Definition: Share of new hires who acknowledged the Employee Handbook within 5 business days of their joining date.
Formula: Acknowledgements within 5 business days / new hires

Metric_Name: Security and privacy training on time
Definition: Share of employees who completed the Information Security and Data Privacy training within the first 30 days of employment.
Formula: Employees trained within 30 days / employees who joined

Definition: Average share of modules completed by employees who have a published learning path, per department. Employees on leave for the whole month are excluded.
Formula: Sum of completed modules / sum of assigned modules

Metric_Name: Quiz pass rate at first attempt
Definition: Share of module quizzes passed at the first attempt, per learning path. Used to find questions or lessons that need review.
Formula: Quizzes passed at first attempt / quizzes attempted

Definition: Share of recurring reports published on or before their publication date, including the monthly reports due on the 5th business day.
Formula: Reports published on time / reports due

Definition: Number of data-handling exceptions found in the quarterly access review: unregistered datasets, access no longer needed, or extracts with personal data kept longer than 14 days.
Formula: Count of exceptions found

Metric_Name: Datasets with a complete register entry
Definition: Share of datasets in the analytics environment whose register entry names an owner, source system, class, refresh frequency and retention period.
Formula: Complete entries / datasets

Definition: Share of security incidents reported to IT Security within 1 hour of discovery, based on the discovery time recorded in the incident log.
Formula: Incidents reported within 1 hour / incidents reported

Definition: Share of production deployments whose deployment log shows a Team Leader sign-off before the deployment started.
Formula: Deployments with sign-off / deployments

Definition: Share of pages answered by the on-call engineer within 15 minutes during the on-call rotation.
Formula: Pages answered within 15 minutes / pages

Definition: Share of production deployments for which the customer was notified at least 24 hours in advance.
Formula: Deployments notified 24 hours ahead / deployments
